HeadAudio integration is experimental and only enabled for the anatomical rig when all 14 speaking Oculus viseme channels exist (silence is neutral, an explicit silence morph is optional). To opt in, provision a rights-cleared compatible 368-byte-record model at runtime/public/branding/aura-headaudio-model.bin before building/running. No sample weights are included or fetched remotely. Missing/malformed model or unsupported AudioWorklet leaves the existing explicitly identified formant tracker active. The upstream English model is not validated for Swedish; do not infer language quality from the presence of the source. No microphone or speaker route is owned by HeadAudio. Verify actual playback, physical morph deformation and hardware performance before production.
